# Ultimate Comparison

- Configuration: L336/O96 only -- the one window every pipeline shares
- Pipelines: Per-channel · Cluster (k=1) · Cluster (k=2) · Cluster (k=3) · Cluster (k=5) · Cluster (k=9) · Multivariate
- Datasets: ED2022, UH2022, EMF2023 (University-5 w/ PTV)
- Models: EMForecaster (2025), DLinear (2023), TSMixer (2023), PatchTST (2023), Transformer (2017), LSTM (1997), ARIMA (1970)
- Caveat: `Cluster (k=1)` is the multivariate network with CCM's clustering switched off (an all-ones sinkhorn assignment, one shared cluster-wise linear, no similarity gradient), so it is the controlled no-clustering baseline. It still carries the cluster assigner's parameters, which is why its weight count exceeds `Multivariate`'s; on DLinear the two cells reproduce each other to four decimals. Runs made before 2026-08-25 by the upstream wrappers are in logs/_archive and are not in these tables.
- Conformal prediction: on for every run

## 1 · Every pipeline side by side

Read **across** a row to rank the models under one pipeline (**bold** = best, <u>underline</u> = runner-up); read **down** a dataset block to see what the same model does per channel, jointly, or with a k-cluster head. `-` = that combination was not run (the cluster grid only covers the four models that have a head to cluster).
